Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the second half! Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana are the openers. Marufa Akter to begin.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

For Bangladesh, can't really talk a lot about a side which has been bowled out for 50! That is not what their skipper would have thought after electing to bowl. Now they are well behind in the game. They will need a miracle to win this one now. India on the other hand, will hope to chase it as quickly as possible.

That is an outstanding bowling performance from India and they dominated the first half of the semi finals. It was Pooja Vastrakar who started things off after being asked to field. She ran through the top order and since then, Bangladesh never recovered. They kept losing wickets. All the bowlers except for Deepti Sharma got a wicket at least. Overall, it is a top performance.
OUT! TIMBER! There is the last wicket! On middle, flatter, Marufa Akter looks to flick but misses and it hits the stumps. Bangladesh Women HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 51!

Commentary.Commentary: It is time for the first semi final and it is India faking on Bangladesh. The former are big time favourites heading into this encounter but it was just recently Bangladesh did well against India in the white-ball format. However, they'll have to be at their best if they are to have a chance here. Can they upset the odds yet again?
... MATCH DAY ...

With a chance to play in the Gold Medal match, India Women and Bangladesh Women go head-to-head in the 1st Semifinal game at the ZJUT Cricket Field. Hangzhou, Zhejiang. With the quarter-finals for both sides being a washout and progress due to a better-seeded side the two sides meet each. India Women had a good outing with the bat against the Malaysia Women's side before the rain played the spoilsport while the game between Bangladesh Women and Hong Kong Women did not even start. India Women have come in with the strongest squad and look like the side to beat in this tournament while Bangladesh Women are a side on the up in the International Women's cricketing arena. the forecast is expected once again with a rain-curtailed game if it happens at all. It would take a stellar effort from Bangladesh Women to give India Women a fight in this crunch game. In the recently concluded bilateral series between both sides, The two teams shared the trophy but had some heated verbals at the end of the game so an exciting contest with a lot of fierce moments could be expected between these sides if weather permits.
